title: When a stablecoin slips
subtitle: How a broken peg can travel beyond one token.
summary: A stable price is a promise about redemption and reserves. Investigate two possible channels: holders seeking redemption, and leveraged positions using the token as collateral. Whether stress spreads depends on reserve quality, market depth and exposure. The episode is simulated; the underlying mechanisms have published sources.

nodes.label: Reserve asset sales
nodes.detail: Liquidity has to come from somewhere

edges.label: The rush to redeem
edges.explanation: A loss of confidence can encourage holders to seek redemption, putting pressure on an issuer's immediately available liquidity.
edges.caveat: Redemption rights, access and the issuer's reserve structure differ. A price deviation alone does not prove a run.

edges.label: The collateral is worth less
edges.explanation: If a lending position uses the affected token as collateral, a lower market price can reduce its collateral value.
edges.caveat: This link requires actual exposure and an oracle that reflects the price change. It does not apply to every protocol.

edges.label: Reserves meet redemption demand
edges.explanation: An issuer may need to turn reserve assets into cash to meet redemptions if its immediately available liquidity is insufficient.
edges.caveat: Cash buffers, short maturities or outside liquidity can absorb the demand without forced sales.

edges.label: A margin threshold is crossed
edges.explanation: A fall in collateral value can trigger liquidation rules in leveraged DeFi positions.
edges.caveat: The borrower may add collateral, repay debt or remain above the liquidation threshold.

edges.label: Selling meets market depth
edges.explanation: Concentrated reserve sales could add pressure to the market for the underlying reserve assets.
edges.caveat: The size, timing and depth of the reserve market determine whether a meaningful spillover occurs.

edges.label: Liquidations consume liquidity
edges.explanation: Forced sales can use up available trading liquidity and amplify stress across connected DeFi markets.
edges.caveat: Other participants may supply liquidity. This map does not estimate the size or direction of an asset's price move.

sources.title: BIS: DeFi risks and the decentralisation illusion
